attacks.scenario: Envelope requirements omit cryptographic proof format, canonical serialization, key root/discovery, revocation/rotation, and concrete maintainer fallback authorization.
attacks.expectedControl: Specify versioned signed envelope, canonical bytes, trusted issuer keys, rotation/revocation, proof retention, and fallback authorization.

attacks.scenario: Append-only index has no authoritative storage or atomic cross-branch reservation/merge protocol.
attacks.expectedControl: Define durable registry, transactional append/reservation, conflict handling, and replay tests.

attacks.scenario: Canonical Candidate digest, dependency closure, and non-evidence classification algorithms are unspecified.
attacks.expectedControl: Specify path ordering, hash inputs, rename/delete behavior, dependency resolution, and one invalidation classifier.

attacks.scenario: Reject-versus-dereference symlink policy and sandbox/environment/executable limits are ambiguous.
attacks.expectedControl: Choose fail-closed policy, define sandbox limits and capabilities, and attest bundle construction/execution.

attacks.scenario: Latest attempt ordering and interaction of failed attempts with supersession are undefined.
attacks.expectedControl: Define monotonic sequence and explicit attempt state machine and selection rule.

attacks.scenario: Risk-to-floor matrix, protected taxonomy, dependency graph source, and unknown-surface adjudication remain unspecified.
attacks.expectedControl: Check in matrix, taxonomy, graph algorithm, and fail-closed maintainer workflow.

attacks.scenario: Evidence boundary path/commit rule and non-circular closeout digest are unspecified.
attacks.expectedControl: Define immutable evidence root, finalization order, inclusion/exclusion, and closeout digest.

attacks.scenario: Transitions, idempotency, cancellation, locks, concurrent repairs, and escalation ownership are incomplete.
attacks.expectedControl: Publish versioned state machine with guarded transitions and fixtures.

attacks.scenario: Affected context and QA allowlists/redaction rules are not canonical, allowing indirect narrative/source leakage.
attacks.expectedControl: Define per-role manifest schemas and reject unclassified inputs.

attacks.scenario: Shared schemas/fields and compatibility/version migration between issues 05 and 08 have no ownership matrix.
attacks.expectedControl: Assign every shared contract and pin versions with compatibility tests.
